summary: Persist the last picked artifact probe for the browser session and expose the canvas/PIXI render-tree results in the Diagnostics UI and copied JSON.

operations.before:
const GHOST_SHIP_KEY = "signatory-ghost-ship";

const { ApplicationV2, HandlebarsApplicationMixin, DialogV2 } = foundry.applications.api;

const diagnostics = await collectSceneDiagnostics(findManagedScene(GHOST_SHIP_KEY), { pointProbe: this.diagnosticPointProbe });
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(diagnosticsClipboardText(diagnostics));

checks.name: Persistent probe storage wired
checks.run: grep -q 'function diagnosticProbeStorageKey' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'sessionStorage' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'collectArtifactPointProbe' scripts/scene-library.mjs

checks.name: Canvas probe UI present
checks.run: grep -q 'Canvas / PIXI point probe' templates/scene-library.hbs && grep -q 'canvasPointProbe.hits' templates/scene-library.hbs
